terms.comment: Our description: linteolum, a small linen cloth (Plaut., Plin., in Lewis & Short), ūmidum, damp. No reference work has a word for a wet wipe.

phrases.latin: Dā mihi linteolum ūmidum; manūs tibi tergam.
phrases.english: Give me a wet wipe; I’ll wipe your hands.

sources: Lewis & Short: linteolum · Lewis & Short: umidus
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
